name: Russian River Valley

contains: Green Valley of Russian River Valley

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Merlot has a distinctive tea-like note, and Zinfandel shows tarter red fruit than in warmer Dry Creek Valley.
Its crisp grapes are prized for sparkling wine.

blurb.text: A cool Sonoma County AVA between Sebastopol and Santa Rosa to the south and Healdsburg to the north, shaped by fog from the nearby Pacific Ocean. It is known for cool-climate Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.
